overview: General info – Applicable to all types of leases (office, retail and or industrial). The most recent commencement date means the date when the lease was most recently renewed/extended. For example, lease commenced on 01/01/2020 to 12/31/2024 and it was renewed on 01/01/2025. So, the most recent lease start date will be 01/01/2025. Most Recent Lease Start Date Can be fetched from latest amendment relating to renewal or extension of the lease If lease is not renewed/extended/expanded, check for Lease Commencement Date (LCD)
preliminary: (Building | Landlord Name| Tenant Name| Lease Guarantor| Suite| Lease Date | Property Name| Street Address| City| State)
General Applicability: All leases (Office, Retail and Industrial)
